name: Smooth Queso Blanco & Warm Flour Tortilla Strips
whyItWorks: Melted white American or Monterey Jack cheese with warm toasted white flour tortillas gives you the chips-and-queso experience without corn chip shrapnel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip diced pickled jalapenos and tomatoes in the queso. Dip warm toasted flour tortilla triangles or soft pretzel bites instead of corn tortilla chips.
